domains.name: chat-platforms
domains.description: Bidirectional chat-platform integration that surfaces session state and accepts control input over Discord and Slack, including reaction-driven dispatch and synthetic personas.

modules.name: discord
modules.description: Discord bot, control UI, session channels, and command handlers (src/discord, src/discord/commands).

modules.name: slack
modules.description: Slack bot, message/thread mapping, and session mirroring repos (src/slack).

modules.name: reaction-workflow
modules.description: Emoji-to-action mapping, workflow planning, and runner harness (src/platform, src/triggers).

modules.name: personas-delegation
modules.description: Dynamic persona generation from signals and delegation templates (src/personas, src/delegation).

domains.name: http-interface
domains.description: External access surfaces: the HTTP/Hono REST API that hooks report to, the MCP server, and the web monitoring frontend.

modules.name: rest-api
modules.description: Hono routers for sessions, spawn, reports, and other v1 endpoints (src/api).

modules.name: web-monitor
modules.description: Vite+React Foundation UI pages, components, and hooks for live monitoring (web/src).

modules.name: mcp-server
modules.description: MCP tool surface exposing Concordia queries to agents (src/mcp).

modules.name: web-client
modules.description: Browser-side UI library (rendering, connection, event wiring) and host/config loading that front the HTTP interface

domains.name: session-coordination
domains.description: Core purpose: track concurrent AI coding agent sessions — register, share progress, detect lost sessions, recover from jsonl, resume, and generate end-of-session reports.

modules.name: session-lifecycle
modules.description: Session registration, heartbeat, end flow, spawn and reaper control (src/control, src).

modules.name: worktree-automation
modules.description: Parallel git worktree detection and management for same-repo/branch sessions (src/work, src/processes).

modules.name: session-reports
modules.description: LLM summarization plus structured aggregation of session events into reports (src/report).

modules.name: lost-recovery
modules.description: Heartbeat sweeper, jsonl transcript parsing, and lost-session candidate handling (src/providers, src/work).

domains.name: persistence
domains.description: Durable state and cross-cutting infrastructure: SQLite repositories for all entities plus shared config, secrets, and auth helpers.

modules.name: repositories
modules.description: SQLite-backed repos for sessions, participants, channels, PRs, and more (src/db).

modules.name: config-secrets
modules.description: Config loading, secret resolution, encryption, and bearer extraction (src/shared, src/auth).

domains.name: observability
domains.description: Cost, resource, and time-based reporting: aggregating spend, sampling host/WSL metrics, and scheduling daily/morning/stat rollups.

modules.name: cost-tracking
modules.description: Cost feed aggregation and usage rate reading across providers (src/cost).

modules.name: host-metrics
modules.description: Host and WSL process/resource snapshots and capture (src/metrics).

modules.name: scheduled-reports
modules.description: Daily, morning, and stat schedulers driving periodic reports (src/daily, src/morning, src/stat).

domains.name: governance
domains.description: Policy and workflow steering: a rule engine that proposes/enacts actions, PR queue reconciliation, role prediction, and admin configuration toggles.

modules.name: pr-queue
modules.description: PR ingestion, reconciliation, and queue building (src/pr).

modules.name: rules-engine
modules.description: Rule evaluation, proposal, and action execution (src/rules, src/role).

modules.name: admin-settings
modules.description: Workspace, chat, and feature toggle administration (src/admin).

domains.name: analysis-core
domains.description: Core Anatomia analysis engine (session cache, parsing) together with skill frontmatter parsing/analysis and model-catalog seeding that feed the analysis pipeline

modules.name: anatomia-engine
modules.description: Core Anatomia analysis engine (session cache, parsing) together with skill frontmatter parsing/analysis and model-catalog seeding that feed the analysis pipeline

domains.name: tooling
domains.description: Automated test suites plus shared test helpers, fixtures, and DB/app/dir factories supporting them

modules.name: test-harness
modules.description: Automated test suites plus shared test helpers, fixtures, and DB/app/dir factories supporting them
